title: Episode 8
summary: A woman's body is found locked in the shack after Mervin went to the airport.
method: The victim was a journalist who was undercover to write a story about turtle egg smuggling. She got into a row with a member of the turtle conservation charity on the boat when she revealed her intention to write a story. She was thrown off the boat and ended up drifting to the beach near the shack. She entered the shack as Mervin was moving his luggage to the car, so he wouldn't have seen her. She found the address of the shack from an old postcard sent to DI Parker and called someone. This turned out to be the killer, and when she revealed her plan to write a story, he strangled her.
motive: The killer was in love with the victim and when it was revealed that she was a journalist intending to write a story about the turtle egg smuggling, he felt betrayed that she seemed to only use him for information. He also wanted too protect his wife and other members of the group.
killer: A member of the turtle conservation charity, with whom the victim was dating
notes: This is Darlene's last full episode. In the Christmas special, she only made a video call appearance.
